qa.topFinding: All 11 MCP packages + trigger-matcher have tests. 1,327+ total tests. 56 new script tests: generate-version-index.test.mjs (31 tests), manifest-helper.test.sh (19 tests), update-component.test.sh (6 tests). Coverage reporting enabled in all packages. Frontmatter validator checks 64+ files with 0 errors/0 warnings.
qa.recommendation: Add integration tests for cross-server scenarios. Consider adding test:scripts to CI pipeline.
qa.riskIfIgnored: Low remaining risk - comprehensive test coverage across all components

uiux.topFinding: PM dashboard (TUI + web) has dark/light theme toggle (persisted in localStorage), keyboard navigation (J/K section nav, T theme toggle, R refresh, ? help), ARIA-friendly focusable cards. Multi-project view also themed. Primarily a CLI toolkit, so UI needs are limited.
uiux.recommendation: Add collapsible sections and responsive mobile layout improvements
uiux.riskIfIgnored: Low risk - UI is secondary to this project's purpose

security.topFinding: All 45 sanitizePath() calls include basePath=process.cwd(). CI secrets scan fails build on findings. execFile() everywhere (no shell injection). npm audit fails on high-severity vulns. update-component.sh uses json_get() via node -e (no eval injection).
security.recommendation: Add SQL injection protection to database-operations, add Content-Security-Policy headers if web dashboard is exposed
security.riskIfIgnored: Low remaining risk - major attack vectors are closed

devops.topFinding: CI restructured for npm workspaces: shared install job with node_modules caching, 13 jobs across ~500 lines. Build/test matrix uses working-directory. Pre-commit hooks via husky + lint-staged. ShellCheck validates all bash scripts. Version index CI job prevents stale component-versions.json.
devops.recommendation: Enable required status checks on main branch (requires repo admin). Add test:scripts job to CI.
devops.riskIfIgnored: CI failures can still be merged without branch protection (GitHub admin setting)

networking.topFinding: Stdio transport (minimal exposure). runServer() provides health check framework. rag-mcp, code-review-mcp, and testing-mcp use startup health checks via commandHealthCheck(). URL sanitization blocks SSRF.
networking.recommendation: Add periodic health checks for long-running servers
networking.riskIfIgnored: Low remaining risk - all exec-based servers verify tool availability at startup

development.topFinding: ESLint zero-tolerance (--max-warnings 0). npm workspaces with shared tsconfig.base.json. Pre-commit hooks via husky + lint-staged. Jest scripts use PATH-resolved jest binary (works with hoisted deps). All 12 packages build and test successfully from workspace root.
development.recommendation: Add type checking (tsc --noEmit) to pre-commit hooks for MCP servers
development.riskIfIgnored: Low remaining risk - comprehensive development guardrails in place

architecture.topFinding: npm workspaces monorepo with 12 packages. Shared tsconfig.base.json eliminates duplicate TS config (path-relative options stay in extending configs). Per-component versioning with component-versions.json index. Manifest v2 with per-component tracking. All servers use runServer() factory from mcp-shared.
architecture.recommendation: Consider adding workspace-level dependency constraints to prevent phantom deps
architecture.riskIfIgnored: Low remaining risk - clean monorepo architecture established

product.topFinding: 86 distributable components: 46 agents, 19 skills, 10 MCP servers, 3 hooks, 6 plugins, 2 integrations. Per-component versioning enables granular updates. /update-check v2.0.0 supports all-components and single-component views. update-component.sh enables one-command updates.
product.recommendation: Keep docs in sync with Claude Code CLI releases. Consider a web-based component browser.
product.riskIfIgnored: Users follow outdated guides as CLI evolves

api.topFinding: MCP tool interfaces are consistent. All use Zod validation, shared errorResponse() with actionable context. Standard response helpers from mcp-shared. runServer() provides unified lifecycle.
api.recommendation: Add input examples to tool descriptions for better discoverability
api.riskIfIgnored: Users may not understand expected input formats

monitoring.topFinding: 100% instrumentation. Log rotation via MCP_LOG_MAX_SIZE_MB (default 10MB). MetricsCollector tracks per-tool p50/p95/p99 latencies. All servers log requestId + durationMs. Startup time tracked via startupMs.
monitoring.recommendation: Wire MetricsCollector.recordCall() into server tool handlers for automated latency tracking
monitoring.riskIfIgnored: Low remaining risk - log rotation prevents unbounded growth

database.topFinding: rag-mcp healthCheck() wired into runServer() startup with retry logic. Adapter pattern supports ChromaDB, Qdrant, Redis. Graceful degradation on failure.
database.recommendation: Add periodic health checks and connection pool monitoring
database.riskIfIgnored: Post-startup connection drops still need manual detection

performance.topFinding: CI benchmark results persisted as JSON artifacts (90-day retention) with per-server build times. 120s total build time SLA warning enforced. npm workspaces reduces install time with dependency hoisting. Single npm install for all 12 packages.
performance.recommendation: Add benchmark comparison step that downloads previous artifact for trend detection
performance.riskIfIgnored: Low remaining risk - benchmark data persisted for trend analysis

documentation.topFinding: Comprehensive documentation: README, QUICKSTART, complete guides, CLAUDE.md, CHANGELOG. All 10 MCP servers have CHANGELOG.md files. All 76 .md/.json components have standardized metadata (author, license, repository, version). Skills README license corrected to Apache-2.0.
documentation.recommendation: Add mcp-shared API docs and usage examples
documentation.riskIfIgnored: New contributors won't know how to use shared library

specifications.topFinding: 5 Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) document key decisions: mcp-shared extraction, per-component versioning, manifest v2 design, npm workspaces, CI pipeline design. component-versions.json schema is self-documenting. MCP tool schemas serve as implicit API specs via Zod.
specifications.recommendation: Add ADRs for future significant decisions. Consider formal spec for component-versions.json schema.
specifications.riskIfIgnored: Future decisions may lack documented rationale

projectDocs.topFinding: CHANGELOG.md tracks all versions (v1.3.0-v2.3.0). docs/decisions/ directory with 5 ADRs and index. Per-MCP-server CHANGELOG.md files. pm-dashboard.json tracks 29 tasks across 12 assessments. Auto-memory preserves cross-session context.
projectDocs.recommendation: Add retrospective documents after major milestones. Consider automated CHANGELOG generation.
projectDocs.riskIfIgnored: Historical context for decisions may fade without written records

progress.topFinding: 29/29 tasks completed. t18 (npm workspaces), t28 (ADRs), t29 (script tests) all done. npm workspaces monorepo working with 12 packages. 5 ADRs written. 56 new script tests passing. v2.3.0 release ready to commit with 130 changed files.
progress.recommendation: Commit and tag as v2.3.0. Plan next iteration priorities.
progress.riskIfIgnored: Uncommitted work at risk until committed
